thread:
maria: Heads-up — Support ticket from Acme. Billing doubled for last billing window. They say 'routing tax' line shows up twice in the invoice. https://support.company/ticket/8921 :grimacing:
aj: ugh. can you paste the charge lines?
maria: here — redacted:
```
Charge components:
- model_tokens: $45.21
- cache_savings_credit: -$12.00
- routing_tax: $8.00
- routing_tax: $8.00
Total: $49.21
```
maria: they only have a single dedicated route, no multi-region setup.
devon: is this the same bug we fixed in route-apply last quarter? that double-counting came up when a fallback route also emitted a routing_tax metric.
aj: sending quick query to check double writes in billing pipeline.
aj: querying logs (can ignore these if noisy):
```
SELECT route_id, charge_type, SUM(amount) as amt
FROM invoice_line_items
WHERE customer_id = 'acme' AND window_start >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route_id, charge_type
ORDER BY amt DESC
```
aj: returned: route_main / routing_tax = 16.00 (expected 8.00)
aj: looks like two separate emit paths created almost identical line items. one from router-service, one from post-processor (prefetch/crediting).
sam: that's bad. do we have unique dedupe keys for invoice lines?
devon: currently dedupe key is invoice_id + line_signature where line_signature = hash(route, charge_type, model_sku, window). But the post-processor appends a suffix for prefetch attribution so hash differs.
blake: so prefetch post-processor is intentionally creating a separate routing_tax line to indicate 'tax applied to prefetch' which used to be rolled up but we changed it to separate for visibility a while back. maybe Acme's UI shows both and that looks like duplication.
maria: customer expects a single routing_tax line. ops support asked for immediate mitigation — can we collapse duplicates on export side?
ej: ops-bot: created incident INC-8921 (severity: low) and flagged billing team.
aj: short-term fix: dedupe by weaker signature — ignore suffix from post-processor. i can patch exporter to normalize line_signature to base_signature(route, charge_type, model_sku, window). That should collapse the two lines. low-risk.
devon: agree but we should be careful: some customers rely on the 'prefetch' separate lines for internal apportionment. we need a console toggle or a separate UI card for "expanded billing view".
sam: long-term we should add an explicit metadata field `source` on invoice lines (router | postprocessor | exporter) and expose it in table, rather than relying on fragile hashes.
blake: +1 for explicit source. also we should add a tooltip in billing card explaining what "routing tax" is and why prefetch shows separately when enabled.
maria: for now can we ship the exporter normalization as a hotfix and communicate to Acme that we're collapsing duplicates? I'll draft a support note. :thumbsup:
aj: i'll open PR with the patch, small change in exporter normalizer to run `line_signature = line_signature.split('#')[0]` before dedupe. test included.
devon: before merging add a feature flag — rollout to prod-oncall first, watch billing exports for 1 hour.
aj: will do feature-flag and 1hr canary in prod region us-west-2.
sam: schedule: PR -> canary -> monitor for incorrect collapses -> global rollout. I'll instrument a metric `billing.duplicate_routing_tax_count` so we can see how many collapsed lines are found after change.
blake: for the console side i'll prototype an "Invoice detail: expanded vs compact" toggle. compact collapses duplicates by default, expanded shows per-source lines. will put a mock in Figma and link here in a bit.
maria: thanks all. sam please coordinate support messaging. aj, devon: ping once canary is green, i'll file customer update.
aj: PR opened: https://git.internal/p/exporter/merge/1111 — canary started. will post monitoring graphs.
devon: quick note for product: we should also consider whether routing_tax should be shown in the per-model econ card or as a global surcharge. different customers will interpret it differently.
maria: noted. product follow-up ok.
blake: Figma link: https://figma.com/file/billing/expanded-invoice-preview (WIP)
aj: canary looks good after 15m, collapsed ~95 duplicates for Acme window, metric `billing.duplicate_routing_tax_count=95`. pushing to 3 more regions now.
sam: support note drafted and queued. sending to Acme in 10m.
maria: great. closing loop after customer ack. :white_check_mark:
